archetype: ARCHETYPE 6 (VIBRANT PLAY) mixed with ARCHETYPE 3 (PASTEL & SOFT)

rules: Small/Labels: text-sm tracking-wide uppercase font-semibold text-slate-500
No pure black or gray, use slate/blue-gray tints.
Use high contrast text for accessibility inside event blocks.

visual_enhancers.corners: rounded-2xl for main containers, rounded-xl for calendar blocks, rounded-full for buttons
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200 for structural elements, softer for inner elements
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for floating action buttons or sticky mobile bottom nav: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-t border-slate-200

grids.desktop_calendar: CSS Grid with 6 columns (1 for time labels, 5 for Mon-Fri) and 12 rows (07:00 to 18:00). Map rows directly to hours.
grids.mobile_calendar: CSS Grid with 2 columns (time labels + single day) or a vertically scrollable list.

layouts.login: Split screen: Left side form (white bg, centered), Right side image covering full height with a subtle overlay.
layouts.dashboard_desktop: Left Sidebar for filters (Team members with colored checkboxes), Week Navigation on top header, Main Calendar grid taking full remaining space.
layouts.dashboard_mobile: Top header with Day/Week toggle, horizontal swipeable days, single-day vertical grid. Floating Action Button (FAB) for '+ Novo compromisso'.

motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and shadow increase on event blocks and buttons.
motion.transitions: transition-transform duration-200 ease-out, transition-colors duration-200 on interactables (never use transition-all globally).
motion.conflict_warning: Gentle pulse animation (animate-pulse) on the border/icon to draw attention to scheduling conflicts without blocking.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast minimums. Text on pastel backgrounds must be dark (e.g., text-blue-900).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='btn-new-appointment', data-testid='login-submit').

image_urls.description: Two women studying together at a table with laptop

responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first approach. Design for small screens (320px-428px) then scale to md and lg.
responsive.layout: On mobile, sidebar becomes a slide-out drawer or bottom sheet. Calendar transitions from Week View (desktop) to Day View (mobile) to prevent horizontal scrolling and squished columns.
responsive.typography: Scale down headings on mobile (text-2xl instead of text-4xl). Inputs must be min 16px font size to prevent iOS zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Add overflow-x-hidden to body. Calendar grid container should scroll vertically but not horizontally (except for day swiping if implemented).
responsive.tap_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all buttons, checkboxes, and time slots.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use .js (JSX) for all React files, NEVER .tsx. The project setup expects JavaScript.
Implement the UI in Portuguese (PT-BR) as requested.
Calendar Grid Logic: Build a CSS Grid for the week view. 1st column for times (07:00 - 18:00), columns 2-6 for Monday-Friday. For precise event positioning, consider mapping hours to grid rows.

Mobile Calendar: Default to a Single Day view to ensure touch targets are large enough, as 5 days will not fit vertically on a phone. Add a day selector at the top. Allow horizontal scrolling if week view is strictly needed on mobile.
Colors: Assign a unique pastel color scheme (bg + text + border) to each user. The sidebar checkboxes should reflect these colors.
Conflicts: If two events overlap, do not block creation. Render them side-by-side or overlapping slightly, and add a warning icon with a tooltip indicating 'Conflito de horário'.
Forms: Use standard Shadcn UI elements (Input, Button, Checkbox, Select, Dialog) customized with our soft, rounded style.
Auth: Create a custom JWT auth mock for 'senha123' requirement.
Testing: Add data-testid attributes to all buttons, inputs, and clickable calendar slots.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics.
Use generous spacing (2-3x normal). Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, specific transitions. Static = dead.
Never apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: left; }).
Use pill-shaped or soft-rounded buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Prioritize reusing pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
